hook.name: Lamplighter's Hook
hook.desc: A long brass pole with a hook for lifting lamp-caps. Every apprentice learns to swing one.

hatchet.name: Iron Hatchet
hatchet.desc: Brann's honest work. Heavy in the head, light in the haft.

ashwood_rod.name: Ashwood Rod
ashwood_rod.desc: A charred staff that stays warm. Fire comes easier when you hold it.

gutting_knife.name: Gutting Knife
gutting_knife.desc: A fisher's knife, thin and wicked. Made for quick work.

hunting_spear.name: Hunter's Spear
hunting_spear.desc: Found in the abandoned camp. The bloodstains are old. Mostly.

saltsteel_saber.name: Saltsteel Saber
saltsteel_saber.desc: Forged from a drowned knight's blade. It never rusts, and it never stops dripping.

censer_flail.name: Bishop's Censer
censer_flail.desc: The Drowned Bishop's censer. Swing it and it breathes out sparks instead of incense.

starsteel_blade.name: Starsteel Blade
starsteel_blade.desc: Brann's masterpiece, forged from ore that fell from the sky before the sky went dark. It hums near Hollows.

oilskin.name: Oilskin Coat
oilskin.desc: Standard guild issue. Smells of whale oil and old rain.

jerkin.name: Boiled-Leather Jerkin
jerkin.desc: Stiff, light, and better than nothing by a good margin.

hauberk.name: Chain Hauberk
hauberk.desc: Riveted rings, oiled against the damp. It jingles. Hollows hate the sound.

wardenplate.name: Wardenplate
wardenplate.desc: Plate from the old Watch, refitted by Brann. Slow, heavy, and very hard to kill.

drowned_mail.name: Drowned Mail
drowned_mail.desc: Scale armour pulled from the Salt Knights. Barnacles in the joints, but it holds.

moth_charm.name: Moth Charm
moth_charm.desc: A paper moth folded around a pinch of lamp-soot. Things find it hard to land a blow on you.

ember_locket.name: Ember Locket
ember_locket.desc: A locket with a coal inside that has never gone out.

saints_tooth.name: Saint's Tooth
saints_tooth.desc: A relic of the chapel. While you carry it, wounds close a little each turn of battle.

wolf_fang.name: Gloam-Wolf Fang
wolf_fang.desc: Strung on sinew. Wearing it makes your grip feel surer.

orrins_ring.name: Orrin's Signet
orrins_ring.desc: The Guildmaster's ring, a little flame cut into a black stone. Your lantern burns slower while you wear it.

draught.name: Healing Draught
draught.desc: Red, bitter, and it works. Restores 30 health.

stew.name: Bowl of Maeve's Stew
stew.desc: Eel, barley, and something Maeve won't name. Restores 15 health and calms you (Dread -10).

tallow.name: Hollow Tallow
tallow.desc: Grey fat rendered from a Hollow. It burns, if you don't mind the smell. Refills 15 oil.

tonic.name: Focus Tonic
tonic.desc: Cold, minty, makes your teeth ache. Grants 6 Focus in battle.

salts.name: Smelling Salts
salts.desc: Clears the head. Removes poison, bleeding, burns, blindness and weakness.

firepot.name: Firepot
firepot.desc: A clay pot of lamp-oil and rag. Throw it in battle to burn every enemy.

honeycake.name: Honeycake
honeycake.desc: Sweet and sticky. Restores 20 health, keeps healing you for a few turns in battle, and calms you (Dread -15).

smokebomb.name: Smoke Pellet
smokebomb.desc: Guaranteed escape from any fight that isn't a boss.

ember_wood.name: Ember Shard (Antler)
ember_wood.desc: A splinter of the old sun, pulled from the Antlered Mother's crown. It is warm and it beats like a heart.

ember_tide.name: Ember Shard (Tide)
ember_tide.desc: A splinter of the old sun, hissing faintly as if it is still being drowned.

ember_ash.name: Ember Shard (Ash)
ember_ash.desc: A splinter of the old sun. If you hold it to your ear you hear singing.

tide_key.name: Tide Key
tide_key.desc: A green bronze key shaped like a wave. The Reeve wore it around his neck.

moonpetal.name: Moonpetal
moonpetal.desc: A pale marsh flower that glows faintly without any light to reflect. Sister Ilse wants these.

starsteel_ore.name: Starsteel Ore
starsteel_ore.desc: A lump of black metal flecked with points of light, like a piece of the night sky from before.

wren_ribbon.name: Wren's Ribbon
wren_ribbon.desc: A yellow hair ribbon, snagged on a thorn. Maeve's daughter wore one like it.

brass_shroud.name: Brass Shroud
brass_shroud.desc: A lantern upgrade fitted by Brann. (Already installed.)

hollow_dust.name: Hollow Dust
hollow_dust.desc: What is left when a Hollow comes apart. Tallow the merchant buys it, for reasons.

wolf_pelt.name: Gloam Pelt
wolf_pelt.desc: Grey fur that is cold to the touch. Sells well.

pearl.name: Black Pearl
pearl.desc: Pulled from something in the marsh. Valuable to the right buyer.

silver_icon.name: Silver Icon
silver_icon.desc: A small saint in tarnished silver from the drowned chapel.

homecoming_charm.name: Homecoming Charm
homecoming_charm.desc: A small brass moth on a chain, warm as a hearthstone. Hold it and think of home ('recall'), or of the last warm place you slept ('return'). It needs a rest to recharge.

rootwood.name: Rootwood
rootwood.desc: Pale, dry timber from the Weeping Wood. The Builder needs it.

saltstone.name: Saltstone
saltstone.desc: Salt-hardened blocks from the Saltmarsh. The Builder needs them.

slag.name: Tallow Slag
slag.desc: Heavy grey clinker from the old mines. The Builder and the Strongroom use it.

relic_ember.name: Ember Relic
relic_ember.desc: Fire burns hotter. Socket it into gear at Brann's forge. Better relics are forged from Hollow Cores.

relic_lamp.name: Lamp Relic
relic_lamp.desc: Flares sear harder. Socket it into gear at Brann's forge. Better relics are forged from Hollow Cores.

relic_edge.name: Edge Relic
relic_edge.desc: Blows land heavier. Socket it into gear at Brann's forge. Better relics are forged from Hollow Cores.

relic_heart.name: Heart Relic
relic_heart.desc: Healing goes further. Socket it into gear at Brann's forge. Better relics are forged from Hollow Cores.

relic_pulse.name: Pulse Relic
relic_pulse.desc: Everything you do hits harder. Socket it into gear at Brann's forge. Better relics are forged from Hollow Cores.

hollow_core.name: Hollow Core
hollow_core.desc: A cold knot of dark left behind when a boss falls. The forge needs it for anything better than Rare.

book_fire.name: Tome of Firebolt
book_fire.desc: A spell book. Equip it at the Magician's tower or with the 'spells' command.

essence_fire.name: Fire Essence
essence_fire.desc: A bottled spark of fire. The Magician binds three into a spell book.

book_ice.name: Tome of Frost Lance
book_ice.desc: A spell book. Equip it at the Magician's tower or with the 'spells' command.

essence_ice.name: Ice Essence
essence_ice.desc: A bottled spark of ice. The Magician binds three into a spell book.

book_water.name: Tome of Tide Surge
book_water.desc: A spell book. Equip it at the Magician's tower or with the 'spells' command.

essence_water.name: Water Essence
essence_water.desc: A bottled spark of water. The Magician binds three into a spell book.

book_light.name: Tome of Radiance
book_light.desc: A spell book. Equip it at the Magician's tower or with the 'spells' command.

essence_light.name: Light Essence
essence_light.desc: A bottled spark of light. The Magician binds three into a spell book.

book_shadow.name: Tome of Soul Drain
book_shadow.desc: A spell book. Equip it at the Magician's tower or with the 'spells' command.

essence_shadow.name: Shadow Essence
essence_shadow.desc: A bottled spark of shadow. The Magician binds three into a spell book.

book_earth.name: Tome of Stone Ward
book_earth.desc: A spell book. Equip it at the Magician's tower or with the 'spells' command.

essence_earth.name: Earth Essence
essence_earth.desc: A bottled spark of earth. The Magician binds three into a spell book.

court_key.name: Crown Key
court_key.desc: A heavy iron key marked THE CROWN. It opens the throne room of the Ember Court.

cinder.name: Cinder Glass
cinder.desc: Black glass fused by the Court's fire. The Builder and the forge use it.

queens_ember.name: The Queen's Ember
queens_ember.desc: A coal from the heart of the Cinder Queen, still warm. It makes every flame and every spell you cast burn a little brighter.
